_comment: Inventory of build-time code generators in CK and the ctest tests their
generated sources feed. This is the source-of-truth record of the codegen
blind spot for smart-build test selection:
B1 - generated .cpp do not exist when the depmap is built (pre-build), so
B2 - a change to a generator INPUT (generate.py / cmake/*.in) maps to NO
test via #include analysis (the depmap has generated.cpp -> headers,
never generate.py -> generated.cpp); no compile-dep tool can see it.
Used by: filter_oracle.py codegen-allowlist (marks these tests as a known
codegen class in the reachability guardrail). Correctness for B2 does NOT
depend on this file being complete - ci_safety_check.sh forces a full build on
any */generate*.py or cmake/*.in change as a backstop.
Root cause is two-part: some add_custom_commands already carry DEPENDS <script>
(e.g. 01_fmha, gemm_streamk) and some don't, but the gap persists even with
DEPENDS because the depmap never parses ninja's CUSTOM_COMMAND edges (it uses the
#include graph + exe<->object only). Retiring this stopgap needs BOTH complete
DEPENDS upstream AND a depmap that chains generator-input -> output -> exe.
Add an entry when you add a generator. Paths are relative to projects/composablekernel.
test_globs use shell-style wildcards matched against `ctest -N` names.
